answer: Make every new agent post a bond at the network inlet before it can earn. The bond acts like pigment in water: once mixed into the ledger it is visible to all, so peers can trace which identities share funding. If two bonded agents are caught attesting to each other's fake work, both bonds are burned. A lantern of public slashing records lets honest agents price the risk, while an attacker must lock real capital per identity and loses it on the first proven collusion, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand bonds.
